purpose: Advisory mapping of stable Project roles to documented OpenAI models; not host configuration or guaranteed account availability.

reasoner.documented_position: Most capable model for demanding work.
reasoner.suggested_use: Unresolved intent, consequential architecture, difficult debugging and acceptance.
reasoner.effort_policy: Use client-supported effort appropriate to risk; increase when evidence requires deeper analysis.

builder.documented_position: Recommended for complex coding and agentic workflows when available.
builder.suggested_use: Sustained implementation of a coherent contract.
builder.effort_policy: Begin with a suitable available default; increase for difficult implementation.

mechanical.documented_position: Efficient model for focused, high-volume work.
mechanical.suggested_use: Optional batches of bounded transformations with strong checks.
mechanical.effort_policy: Use supported controls; do not downshift when interruption or integration risk outweighs savings.

fallback: Retain the current sufficiently capable model. Check host availability before suggesting a successor. Do not invent aliases, effort enums, prices or access.
constraints: No automatic model calls or global config mutation.
No automatic policy update during a build.
No claim that model-card positioning validates this workflow.
No assumption that cache is reusable across models.
